topic: household refrigerator: it does not make cold, it moves heat from inside to outside (vapor-compression loop)
title_fixed_en: How does a fridge get cold?

blender.camera_type: one main three-quarter side cutaway of the fridge (inside on the left, back coils right, compressor bottom right) for at least 60 percent of runtime; short medium shots that always return to it
groups: fridge body as a clean white box with the near side panel removed by a flat cut plane
two simple food items inside (carton, apple) as heat sources
one refrigerant loop: inner evaporator pipe, compressor, zigzag back condenser coil, thin capillary passage
refrigerant fill shader: blue when cold, red-orange when hot, color change placed exactly after the compressor and after the capillary
heat dots: small glowing orange particles with controlled paths (not a physics simulation)
analogy set: one hand with an alcohol droplet that evaporates
final room set: simple room cross-section, the same fridge, one simple person figure, room color tint that warms
model_detail: large clean shapes with small bevels; no insulation layers, fans, wires, shelves, frost or vapor clouds
pipes as smooth tubes with a slightly transparent wall so the refrigerant color is visible
compressor as a simple rounded can with one visible piston in its cutaway
blender.materials: matte white and light grey bodies; blue/red refrigerant; orange heat dots; bright even light; soft shadows; AgX

color_roles.named_part_highlight: soft yellow rim glow for about 1.5 s
color_roles.exception_note: this topic uses blue/red as temperature meaning instead of a single hero accent

visual_direction.layout_reference: config/higgsfield-typecast.json layout v4 (fixed title only, captions without panel)
visual_direction.viewer_follows: the orange heat dots: they go into the inner pipe, travel with the refrigerant and leave at the back coil
style_frames: main cutaway, dots entering the inner pipe
compressor medium shot, blue turning red
full loop, few dots inside and many outside
room cross-section of the final info

sound_design: soft room tone, fridge door and light click, gentle flow through pipes, compressor hum, warm air release at the back coils, thin hiss at the capillary, summer room ambience, one low hit for the reaction and one for the summary line; Piljae remains dominant
guards: heat is absorbed in the inner pipe and released at the outer coil; never show cold being produced by the compressor or refrigerant
refrigerant is the same fluid circulating in a closed loop; never consumed or refilled
refrigerant is hot after the compressor and cold after the narrow passage; color changes exactly there
heat dots move only along the loop direction: food/air -> inner pipe -> compressor -> back coil -> room
the final claim is about the whole room temperature; a little cool air at the open door may be shown
generic simplified household fridge; no brand, refrigerant name, temperature or power figures
use shared layout v4: one fixed title y=500-660, captions y=1140-1380 without background, horizontal center x=540; no step chips, step headings or part labels
clarity before texture: only the parts listed in blender.groups; one main cutaway view keeps the same orientation
measure final Piljae narration before committing shot times; if it runs long, lengthen the video instead of trimming speech
each generated source duration must cover its final timeline span
